scope: Finite Web original-material frame+fill and empty/fullbar planes only; not native GUI, font, percentage parsing, default anchors, source percentage evaluator, tile origin, or layer sorting certification.

sampling.mapper: Independent piecewise point pull at output pixel centers: leading/trailing slices1:1; center floor((i-leading+.5)*sourceCenter/destCenter).
sampling.layering: control fill first then frame. Bar empty first then full image clip; nub paint hidden only.
sampling.alpha: straight RGBA byte source-over onto opaque output; round nearest byte each layer. Frame/bar binary alpha; uniform controlRGB9 alpha.8 gives rounded(14,17,20) over#203040; no .5ties.
sampling.compare: all500×301×4 bytes; whole planes, external backdrop included

notQualified: conditional stack layout/collapse and source %c evaluator
native tiled nub phase/stretch/alpha and GPU premultiplication
native font/rendering, title assets/position, source input lifecycle
full-screen safezone, background loading bars and animations

cases.paintIsolation: All title/description/warning glyph paint, all buttons, both progress image paint and nub paint, platform logo paint visibility:hidden; preserve boxes/geometry. Source common_panel close remains ignored defaultfalse.
